CustomField.description: Defines whether Contact__c holds a commercial role within the supplier's organization, and defines certain permissions granted to him/ her for the related Negoscope__c. By default in Connect, a contact who has Primary or Secondary commercial role in COD will be able to gain access to records related to the Negoscope in the following objects : NetPriceStatement__c, SellInStatement__c, PriceListStatement, ProductPriceDiscountStatement__c, SellInStatement__c, Negoscope__c, ContractServices, RFx__c, Product__c, SupplierPgMapping__c, Negoptim_File__c (RT = Contract, Sales Terms, Purchasing_Terms, Objection_Letter, Contract, Apendix, Datasharing, Market Review)
CustomField.label: Commercial Role
